# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 68 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | Coptic

---

## Saying 68

**1** Jesus said: "Blessed are you when you are hated and persecuted; no place will be found where you were persecuted."

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- The semicolon links the beatitude with its promise without implying causation
- "Where you were persecuted" — past tense marks the completion of the persecution
- The enigmatic promise is left untranslated-over; the strangeness of the Coptic is preserved
